text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio had practically dragged me
to a karaoke booth, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Lady Teio's Special Live
is about to begiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooooo!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Pardon the intrusion! A drink delivery from the Goddess of Bounty, Golshi-chan, to you common folk!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what the heck is this?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um... none of these drinks look like
a color that's safe to drink, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaah?! You're saying you won't drink my special mixed juice packed with love and chaos?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez!! Forget drinks, it's all about singing! Singing! Everyone, listen to my soooong~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! What nerve, stomping all over someone's goodwill.
Sounds like this one needs some punishment!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Batting first, the pitcher: Golshi-選手!
She winds up with the juice... and strikes it in!!
choice_data_list: I'm not going to make it in time...!

text_block_list.text:
Instinctively, I stepped in front of Tokai Teio to shield her.
The taste of the juice poured straight into my mouth was...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
Trainer shielded me and now they're—!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Thank goodneeeeess!!
choice_data_list: Never mind that, it's time to train!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

300 Umapyoi vocalizations, 300 scale practices,
300 rhythm drills with a tambourine,
solo and harmony vocal rehearsals for every song.

"Once that's done, practicing singing while dancing...
Oh, right! I need to train my abs too.
Alright! 300 sit-ups on the sofa—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!!
Trainer, turn back to normal pleeeeeease!!" his

I don't remember much about that time.
I just feel like I gave them thorough training and we spent a truly fulfilling time together.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wabu!?
............Wait, it's tasty?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No way!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Totally, totally! The color looks crazy, but it's sweet and kinda makes power surge through you, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Right now, I feel like
I could do an amazing dance!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Check this out~♪
Spin, spin, spiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible, Teio-san!
It's so amazing that my eyes... my eyes are...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaeeee...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How's that, are you all in awe now~?! Hahaha~♪

Her abnormally high spirits
make me worry for her well-being, but—

The sharpness of the dance had improved considerably,
making one hope this feeling would stick.
